comparison.objective: Place and center a gasket between spread flanges and insert four bolts; candidate transfers a bearing block across a rail–jig junction.
comparison.physical_skill: Record tests planar gasket placement in an occluded gap and repeated vertical bolt insertion. Candidate tests maintaining flush, parallel linear supports during continuous sliding of a free-ball assembly.
comparison.success_condition: Record requires a flat centered gasket and all bolts seated, still, and released. Candidate requires complete transfer with every ball still circulating/contained and no gap, impact, contamination, or unsafe inclination.
comparison.reason: The record is multi-part placement and peg insertion; it lacks continuity of a raceway and preservation of loose internal elements during motion.
